sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BLOCKING WILL REMAIN PROMINENT WITHIN THE LARGE-SCALE UPPER FLOW PATTERN IMPACTING MUCH OF NORTH AMERICA THROUGH THIS PERIOD AND BEYOND. WITHIN THIS REGIME...AND TO THE SOUTHEAST OF A HIGH CENTER OVER THE CENTRAL CANADIAN PRAIRIES...A SIGNIFICANT IMPULSE IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE SLOWLY SHIFTING ACROSS AND SOUTH OF THE CENTRAL CANADIAN/U.S. BORDER AREA. AS THIS OCCURS...A CLOSED LOW ...NOW OVER THE CENTRAL PLAINS...APPEARS LIKELY TO CONTINUE SHIFTING SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE OZARK PLATEAU AND MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...CONTRIBUTING TO SIGNIFICANT FURTHER WEAKENING OF EASTERN U.S. UPPER RIDGING. STABILIZATION ASSOCIATED WITH COOL...DRY AIR SURGING SOUTHWARD TO THE LEE OF THE ROCKIES...IN THE WAKE OF THE CLOSED LOW...WILL END CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL THROUGH MUCH OF THE PLAINS TODAY. BUT...AHEAD OF THE FRONT...A SEASONABLY WARM AND MOIST AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AND THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY FROM THE MID AND LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY EASTWARD THROUGH THE APPALACHIANS...AND SOUTHWARD THROUGH MUCH OF THE MID AND SOUTH ATLANTIC COAST STATES. MODELS ARE ALSO SUGGESTIVE THAT A GRADUALLY DESTABILIZING ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION...EAS

sections.title: UPR PORTIONS OF THE LWR MS VALLEY INTO PARTS OF TN VALLEY
sections.text: MODELS INDICATE THAT A PRE-FRONTAL CORRIDOR OF STRONGER SURFACE HEATING WILL OCCUR ALONG AN AXIS EXTENDING NORTH NORTHEASTWARD OUT OF THE TEXAS COASTAL PLAIN INTO THE VICINITY OF THE CONFLUENCE OF THE MISSISSIPPI AND OHIO RIVERS BY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. THIS IS EXPECTED TO PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR SIGNIFICANT BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION AND ENHANCED CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL...AS A 40-50 KT 500 MB JET STREAK NOSES EAST SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE OZARK PLATEAU THIS AFTERNOON...INTO THE NORTH CENTRAL GULF STATES THIS EVENING. MIXED LAYER CAPE IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE UP TO AROUND 2000 J/KG...WITH MID-LEVEL COOLING AND LIFT IN THE EXIT REGION OF THE SPEED MAXIMUM. COUPLED WITH FAVORABLE DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR...THIS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT. A FEW SUPERCELLS APPEAR POSSIBLE...BEFORE CONVECTION CONSOLIDATES/GROWS UPSCALE INTO A MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WITH A BROADER SCALE DAMAGING WIND THREAT...IN ADDITION TO THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. HIGHEST PROBABILITIES APPEAR TO EXIST ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN/MIDDLE TENNESSEE...NORTHEAST MISSISSIPPI AND NORTHWESTERN ALABAMA BY EARLY EVENING. ..KERR.. 05/13/2011

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY INTO MS/AL
sections.text: MORNING WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER LOW OVER EASTERN KS. THIS FEATURE WILL MOVE SLOWLY EASTWARD ACROSS MO TODAY...WITH CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT AND MID LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS SPREADING ACROSS THE MID/LOWER MS VALLEY AND MUCH OF THE TN VALLEY. AREAL COVERAGE OF MORNING CONVECTION OVER MS/TN IS EXPECTED TO DIMINISH THROUGH THE DAY AS ACTIVITY SPREADS EASTWARD. A FEW OF THE STRONGER STORMS THIS MORNING AND EARLY AFTERNOON MAY POSE A RISK OF HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS OVER AL BEFORE MOVING INTO MORE STABLE AIR OVER GA. BY EARLY AFTERNOON...COOL MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER LOW WILL STEEPEN LAPSE RATES AND LEAD TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT OVER PORTIONS OF SOUTHEAST MO/NORTHEAST AR. THESE STORMS WILL INTENSIFY AND SPREAD EASTWARD INTO PORTIONS OF IL/KY/TN THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WITH A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. MODELS ARE GENERALLY CONSISTENT IN DEVELOPING STORMS SOUTHWARD THIS EVENING INTO MUCH OF MS...AND EVENTUALLY INTO WESTERN AL.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: STRONG DAYTIME HEATING AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S WILL LEAD TO MODERATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY OVER PORTIONS OF SC/NC AND SOUTHERN VA /MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2000 J/KG/. LARGE SCALE FORCING MECHANISMS ARE HARD TO IDENTIFY AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER...MODELS ARE CONSISTENT IN DEVELOPING A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS LATER TODAY OVER THIS REGION. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST SUFFICIENTLY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND VERTICAL SHEAR TO POSE A RISK OF ORGANIZED STORMS PRODUCING HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: SOUTH FL
sections.text: STRONG INSTABILITY AND WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR ARE FORECAST FOR LATER TODAY OVER CENTRAL/SOUTH FL. AN ISOLATED SEVERE STORM IS POSSIBLE IN THIS AREA...BUT AREAL COVERAGE OF SEVERE STORMS DOES NOT APPEAR TO WARRANT A SLIGHT RISK AT THIS TIME. ..HART/STOPPKOTTE.. 05/13/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ERN TN ACROSS CAROLINAS
sections.text: ...MID MS VALLEY INTO MS AND AL... UPPER LOW TRACKING SLOWLY EWD ACROSS SERN KS/SRN MO TO LWR OH VALLEY BY 12Z SAT. SOMEWHAT DISORGANIZED SURFACE LOW OVER THE OH/MID MS VALLEY THIS MORNING AS A COLD FRONT MOVES EWD FROM ITS CURRENT POSITION SCENTRAL MO SWD THRU CENTRAL AR TO ACROSS MS RIVER BY LATER THIS AFTERNOON. CONSIDERABLE OVERNIGHT CONVECTION HAS BEEN MAKING ITS WAY EWD ACROSS MID TN INTO NRN MS/AL THIS MORNING. CLEARING HAS OCCURRED IN THE WAKE OF MORNING ACTIVITY ALONG MS RIVER VALLEY FROM SERN MO SWD INTO NR LA WHICH WILL LEAD TO STRONG HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION THIS AREA WHERE IT IS STILL QUITE MOIST. WITH HEIGHT FALLS AND STRONGER MID/UPR FLOW SPREADING EWD ACROSS MID MS/TN VALLEYS THIS AFTERNOON...STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REDEVELOP ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. MLCAPES WILL CLIMB TO IN EXCESS OF 2000 J/KG PRIOR TO FROPA WHICH COUPLED WITH 35-40 OF BRN SHEAR...SHOULD LEAD TO A FEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON. SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE EARLY IN THE CONVECTIVE INITIATION PERIOD...RAISING POTENTIAL FOR BOTH LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. STORMS ARE LIKELY TO GROW UPSCALE BY THIS EVENING INTO MORE OF A LINEAR MODE WITH WIND DAMA

sections.title: ERN TN/CAROLINAS
sections.text: REF MCD 773 WHILE THE AREA WILL BE INFLUENCED BY A TRANSITORY UPPER RIDGE TODAY...STRONG DAYTIME HEATING AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S WILL LEAD TO MODERATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY FROM SRN APPALACHIANS EWD ACROSS THE CAROLINAS WITH MLCAPES AOA 1500 J/KG COMMON. WHILE LARGE SCALE FORCING MECHANISMS ARE NOT EVIDENT....THE INSTABILITY LINE NOW MOVING EWD ACROSS TN WILL ENCOUNTER A MDTLY UNSTABLE AND UNCAPPED AIR MASS AS IT APPROACHES THE SRN APPALACHIANS EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. THUS HAVE EXTENDED THE SLIGHT RISK WWD INTO ERN TN FOR THIS SCENARIO. AS LOW CLOUDS DISSIPATE EARLY THIS AFTERNOON E OF APPALACHIANS...CONDITIONS WILL SUPPORT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS IN A RELATIVELY LOW SHEAR ENVIRONMENT. HOWEVER CONDITIONS WILL FAVOR LARGE HAIL AND LOCAL DAMAGING WINDS GIVEN THE AMOUNT OF INSTABILITY THAT WILL BE PRESENT. A MORE ORGANIZED LINE OF STORMS COULD MOVE OFF THE SRN APPALACHIANS BY MID AFTERNOON WITH BOTH A WIND AND HAIL THREAT. ..HALES/ROGERS.. 05/13/2011

sections.title: SOUTHEAST QUARTER OF THE CONUS
sections.text: FORECAST REMAINS ON TRACK...AS SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ACROSS MUCH OF THE U.S. NEAR AND EAST OF THE MS RIVER...AHEAD OF A LARGE UPPER LOW NOW CENTERED OVER MO. GREATEST AREA OF SEVERE POTENTIAL -- INCLUDING THREATS FOR LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS -- REMAINS APPARENT ACROSS THE MID MS/LOWER OH/TN VALLEY REGION AND SWD INTO MS/AL...AHEAD OF THE UPPER LOW CENTER WHERE STRONGER/ACCOMPANYING FLOW ALOFT EXTENDS ATOP THE SURFACE WARM SECTOR. FARTHER E...WEAKER SHEAR BUT AMPLE INSTABILITY ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SRN APPALACHIANS REGION CONTINUES TO SUGGEST A SOMEWHAT LESS ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER EVENT...BUT MARGINAL HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH STRONGER STORMS/STORM CLUSTERS THROUGH EARLY EVENING. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT EXISTS ACROSS A LARGER AREA...INCLUDING THE CENTRAL GULF COAST NWD TO THE SRN UPPER GREAT LAKES...AND EWD TO THE UPPER OH VALLEY AND CAROLINA COAST. AN ISOLATED SEVERE STORM MAY ALSO DEVELOP ACROSS CENTRAL OR SRN FL...INVOF SEA BREEZE BOUNDARIES MOVING INLAND FROM BOTH COASTS THIS AFTERNOON. ..GOSS.. 05/13/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1122 AM CDT FRI MAY 13 2011/
